title: HydroAgent: Formalizing Forecaster Expertise into Skill-Orchestrated Flood Forecasting Workflows

claim.summary: HydroAgent encodes hydrological expertise as executable skills linking analog-case prior judgment, scheme selection, simulation and human-reviewed warning workflows.

modules.name: Explicit skill contracts and deterministic executors
modules.scope_reason: Skill boundaries separate procedural control, LLM interpretation and deterministic artifact generation; mechanism can be reused beyond hydrology.
evidence_locators: PDF p.10; passage beginning "The skill layer defines the procedure"

modules.name: Analog flood judgment with physical and human checks
modules.scope_reason: Prior peak/volume intervals are grounded in similar floods and hydrological rules, then reviewed before scheme selection.
evidence_locators: PDF p.10; passage beginning "The Step 1 skill formalizes"

modules.name: Flood-type-indexed calibration and rolling simulation
modules.scope_reason: XAJ parameter schemes calibrated by flood type feed a rolling flood forecasting workflow.
evidence_locators: PDF p.8; passage beginning "In Step 0, scheme preparation"
